name: Assignment
description: Assigns the instance to one principal at a time. A principal may assign an unassigned instance to itself and unassign itself; assigning another principal, reassigning, and unassigning another principal need the config's permission. While the instance is assigned, only its assignee may take its lease (Lease's acquire) or claim it (Queue's claim).

permission.description: The permission a principal needs to assign the instance to another principal, reassign it, or unassign another principal. Absent, only the first two self-service moves are possible.

fields.name: assignee
fields.description: The principal the instance is assigned to; absent when it is unassigned.

operations.name: assign
operations.description: Assigns the instance to a principal: the caller itself when it is unassigned, or anyone, reassigning included, with the config's permission.

operations.name: unassign
operations.description: Clears the assignment: the assignee itself, or a principal with the config's permission.

assignee.description: The principal it was assigned to.

vetoes.description: The instance is assigned to another principal, who alone may acquire its lease or claim it.
The instance is already assigned to that principal.
The config names no permission, which assigning another principal, reassigning and unassigning another principal need.
